form_note: Every arrangement is theme, pulse, open, return. The open section is thinner and has no drums, percussion, bass, or lead. The return restates motif A. Motif and pulse do not share a section. A bar stays 3840 ticks.

kits.bass_line: k01.bass.a starts bar 1 D3, bar 3 C3, bar 5 G2, bar 7 A2.
cycles: Keys A changes chord every two bars: D dominant seventh, C major seventh, G major seventh, A minor seventh.
The open section is keys B, pulse B, and pad B. It has no drums, no bass, and no motif.
The return places motif A again, with the same drums, bass, keys, and pad as the theme.
departures: k01.lead.b G#4 at tick 11520 is outside D Mixolydian.
kits.identity: Iron Gate is D Mixolydian at 128. The keys hold one chord for two bars, then rest before the next. The motif leaves a rest on the downbeat, rises a minor third, and sits out two later bars. Drums keep the kick on beat 1 and the snare on beat 3. The pulse uses straight eighths for four bars and is silent after that.
kits.limitations: Motif B is an alternate file. It is not placed in the arrangement, so it does not sit on the theme. The pulse and the motif are in different sections. Do not stack them.

kits.identity: Ferry Light is F major at 136. The motif moves by a major second, then a step down, with shorter notes than the other kits. The keys stab off the beat. The first chord is Bb major seventh. Bass B ends on F#3. Keys B ends on D major, which includes F#4. Motif B also sounds F#4.
kits.limitations: Bb is in F major. The three F# notes are outside F major. They are not a modulation. Motif B is an alternate and is not stacked on the return.

note_policy: Note-only MIDI. No program changes, controllers, pitch bend, aftertouch, or SysEx.

preview_excerpt.reason: The preview is an excerpt of the 32-bar Iron Gate arrangement. Bars 17-24 are the open section. Bars 25-31 are the start of the return, and the return restates lead A. Bars 1-16, the opening theme and the pulse, stay in the MIDI and are not in the MP3. The full arrangement is longer than 40 seconds.

range_statement: Drums use MIDI channel index 9, the GM channel 10, and only the mapped pitches 36 kick, 37 side stick, 38 acoustic snare, 39 clap, 40 electric snare, 42 closed hat, 46 open hat, and 49 crash. Bass is monophonic, MIDI 41 to 62, channel 1, and it avoids the drum pitches. Harmonic keys allow four notes, MIDI 48 to 76, channel 2. Motif is monophonic, MIDI 60 to 86, channel 3. Sequence is monophonic, MIDI 52 to 81, channel 4. Pad allows four notes, MIDI 48 to 81, channel 5. C4 is 60.
seed_meaning: Seeds identify kits. Nothing is random.
stack_warning: Use either the combined arrangement or the separate parts. Do not stack the part files on top of the combined file.
